name: KAJE
notes:
Address and hours confirmed directly on the site. Gowanus, Brooklyn — this registry's first Gowanus entry (nearest existing district tags are Red Hook/Sunset Park). Homepage shows a rotating grid of recent/current shows (e.g. 'Vault Gowanus', works by Michael E. Smith) rather than a clean current/upcoming split — treat exhibition data as unverified-current until a crawl confirms it.

Added 2026-08-19 at user request. Fingerprint: site markup suggests Kirby CMS (no adapter available yet — starts on manual).

Adapter (2026-10-07): manual -> html. Kirby site; /current and /upcoming sections: h3.date, h2.title (artist), h3.subtitle (show title).

Images (2026-10-07): config.page_image = "img.lazy" — kaje.world show pages have lazy-loaded installation photos but no og:image; pipeline/images.ts uses it to backfill each show image from its own page.
